analysis.name: task_phase_confound
analysis.final_conclusion: Hidden states contain additional collision-predictive information beyond measured task progress, EEF pose, and action magnitude.

distinction.stage_information_exists: Observable timestep, pose, and action features have non-chance scenario-level prediction, so measured task progress information is present in the capture.
distinction.stage_information_not_complete: The primary hidden-only OOF result is compared with the strongest observable OOF candidate; a residual gap means the measured covariates do not fully explain the hidden signal, without claiming that all task-phase confounds are excluded.
distinction.causal_scope: Associational frozen-capture evidence only; it does not establish a pure or causal collision representation.

paired_classification_pool.definition: all wall rows + all paired nowall rows; each fold holds out one wall scenario and its nowall counterpart

definition.matching: nearest timestep within each control scenario
definition.control_order: match separately within each scenario, average within scenario, then macro-average across scenarios
definition.safe_offpath_definition: offpath scenarios with no crashed episode; partially/fully crashing offpath scenarios are excluded
definition.nowall_rows: paired no-wall scenario with the same scenario_id as the held-out wall
definition.probe_scope_per_fold: only the other four wall scenarios and their four paired nowall scenarios
definition.primary_score: strict OOF logit from the fold probe; no full-data frozen probe used

scenario_level_classification.unit: held-out wall scenario; all frames are scored within a scenario, then metrics are macro-averaged
